headline: Build Your 3-Watch Collection
stop_reason: Not built. Three blockers, none fixable within this run's budget. (1) The $25K total in the hook is not supported: the verified library's prices under $3,000 top out at $2,850 (Fears BS23800B.047.124, checked 2026-11-22), so no set of dated library prices can fill three tiers summing to $25K. The hook would need a lower total or more researched models. (2) The library has no confirmed model-type labels (dress, diver, chronograph, field), and each tier needs a type confirmed from an official page before drafting. (3) Every candidate needs its own sourced, dated price and a clean studio cutout photo; this run did not have budget to research those. Next step: owner or next run picks a lower total (for example about $5K) and researches types and photos for three tiers.
